summary: Verified mobile bug fix: all six floating hero tool assets now render and are visible on mobile (375x760) with opacity=1 and display=block after preloader. Desktop regression (1366x800) passes — all six panels visible at full scale, no overlap with nav or headline. Headline 'good design sells' intact on both viewports with 'sells' in orange.

issues: Minor: hero-tool-path (x=120, y=53, w=144) and hero-tool-character (x=200, y=68) occupy same top band and visually touch/overlap; acceptable as a layered design decoration but worth noting.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Mobile hero animation bug fix confirmed working. All 6 testids (hero-tool-character/ease/timeline/path/text/fx) render visible on mobile and desktop after ~9s wait (preloader + entrance delays). Panels are correctly positioned around the centered headline without blocking the Himanshu logo or hamburger menu.
rca of the issue: Original bug: panels used `hidden sm:block` so they were display:none below sm. Fix removed the hidden class and added responsive scale (scale-[0.62] sm:scale-90 lg:scale-100) + mobile-adjusted top/left positions. Verified via computed display=block and opacity=1 at 375px width.
